column3: Platform Foundations: Infrastructure & DevOps
column4:
h3. Goal
Reproducible, auto-scaling AWS EKS platform provisioned 100% from Terraform, with blue/green CI/CD and Datadog tracing from day one.

h3. Definition of Done
A fresh AWS account can be brought to a running staging environment in under 60 minutes from `terraform apply` with zero manual console steps.

h3. Scope
* 11 tickets, 65 story points
* Sprints 1–6 (Phase 0)
* Component: Platform

column3: Identity, Security & Compliance
column4:
h3. Goal
Centralised identity (students, parents, teachers, school admins), encryption everywhere, and compliance with Tunisian Law 2004-63 (INPDP) plus GDPR-equivalent controls for minors' data.

h3. Definition of Done
External penetration test passes with no High/Critical findings; data-protection impact assessment signed off before first pilot school.

h3. Scope
* 10 tickets, 60 story points
* Sprints 2–15 (Phase 0)
* Component: Security

column3: Event-Driven Telemetry & Data Warehouse
column4:
h3. Goal
Every learner micro-interaction (slider drag, hover, hesitation, confidence, answer) is captured as a schema-versioned Kafka event and lands in Snowflake within 5 minutes and in Redis within 200 ms.

h3. Definition of Done
Sustained 50k events/sec with p99 end-to-end lag < 5 min to warehouse; zero schema-breaking deploys thanks to the registry.

h3. Scope
* 10 tickets, 68 story points
* Sprints 3–9 (Phase 1)
* Component: Data

column3: Curriculum Knowledge Graph & Content Pipeline (multi-subject)
column4:
h3. Goal
A subject-agnostic content system: knowledge-component graphs, a tagged and calibrated item bank, a textbook RAG corpus and a teacher authoring workflow, where every object carries a first-class `subject` and `track` (Bac section). Physics is the first subject loaded here; the other four load through E13 on the same tooling.

h3. Definition of Done
Tooling supports any subject with zero code changes; Physics track published with ≥ 400 KCs and ≥ 6,000 tagged items, each with ≥ 1 KC tag and pedagogical review.

h3. Scope
* 9 tickets, 81 story points
* Sprints 3–11 (Phase 1)
* Component: Curriculum

column3: Deep Knowledge Tracing Core
column4:
h3. Goal
Self-hosted SAINT+ model (pyKT) predicting per-concept failure probability, with IRT cold-start fallback, weekly automated retraining and sub-50 ms online inference.

h3. Definition of Done
AUC ≥ 0.80 on held-out Tunisian cohort data; p99 inference latency ≤ 50 ms at 2,000 RPS; weekly retrain runs unattended with automatic rollback on metric regression.

h3. Scope
* 10 tickets, 84 story points
* Sprints 6–10 (Phase 2)
* Component: ML

column3: Adaptive Routing & Recommendation Service
column4:
h3. Goal
Per-click decision engine that turns DKT predictions + the knowledge graph into the next item, next hint level, or next concept, with spaced-repetition scheduling and exam-date awareness.

h3. Definition of Done
Routing decision returned in ≤ 80 ms p99 end-to-end; A/B framework shows measurable learning-gain lift vs. fixed-sequence control.

h3. Scope
* 8 tickets, 57 story points
* Sprints 7–13 (Phase 2)
* Component: ML

column3: Multi-Model LLM Gateway & Guardrails
column4:
h3. Goal
LiteLLM proxy fronting OpenAI / Anthropic / local models with semantic caching, curriculum-grounded RAG over pgvector, and an LLM-as-a-Judge harness with pluggable per-subject verifiers (symbolic for maths/physics/technique, rubric-based for éco/gestion) that blocks hallucinated content before it reaches a student.

h3. Definition of Done
Judge blocks ≥ 95% of seeded formula hallucinations with ≤ 3% false-block rate; semantic cache hit rate ≥ 35%; per-student daily LLM cost capped and enforced.

h3. Scope
* 10 tickets, 77 story points
* Sprints 6–11 (Phase 2)
* Component: LLM

column3: Socratic AI Tutor Experience
column4:
h3. Goal
A streaming, bilingual (Arabic / French) Socratic tutor that asks before it tells, escalates hints in levels, cites the official textbook, and never gives the full answer on first ask.

h3. Definition of Done
≥ 70% of tutor sessions end with the student answering correctly without the final answer being revealed; CSAT ≥ 4.2/5 in pilot.

h3. Scope
* 7 tickets, 42 story points
* Sprints 9–14 (Phase 3)
* Component: Frontend

column3: Interactive Learning Frontend (Next.js / WebGL)
column4:
h3. Goal
A per-subject widget package system on React Three Fiber, with the physics package (mechanics, circuits, optics, waves) built first, an offline-first PWA that survives outages mid-assessment, and real-time peer trivia battles.

h3. Definition of Done
Lighthouse performance ≥ 85 on a mid-range Android device over 3G; a 20-minute assessment completes with the network cut for 5 minutes and syncs losslessly.

h3. Scope
* 11 tickets, 114 story points
* Sprints 4–13 (Phase 3)
* Component: Frontend

column3: Learner Engagement & Gamification
column4:
h3. Goal
Streaks, XP, leaderboards and smart nudges computed in real time from the Kafka stream via Redis, tuned for exam-season motivation rather than vanity metrics.

h3. Definition of Done
Day-7 retention ≥ 40% in pilot; leaderboard reads p99 < 20 ms.

h3. Scope
* 5 tickets, 26 story points
* Sprints 10–14 (Phase 3)
* Component: Backend

column3: Institution & Parent B2B Portals (Multi-Tenancy)
column4:
h3. Goal
Strict PostgreSQL RLS tenant isolation, a teacher dashboard with cohort anomaly detection and intervention alerts, a parent portal, and seat-based Stripe billing for schools.

h3. Definition of Done
Cross-tenant data access is impossible by construction (verified by automated RLS test suite); a school can be onboarded and billed with zero engineering involvement.

h3. Scope
* 9 tickets, 79 story points
* Sprints 6–16 (Phase 4)
* Component: Backend

column3: Observability, Quality & Release Readiness
column4:
h3. Goal
Prove the system survives Bac-eve traffic: load tests at 50k concurrent users, chaos experiments, DR drills, SLOs with alerting, and a launch war-room runbook.

h3. Definition of Done
50k-concurrent load test passes all SLOs; RPO ≤ 15 min, RTO ≤ 1 h demonstrated in a drill; on-call rotation and runbooks signed off.

h3. Scope
* 10 tickets, 81 story points
* Sprints 6–18 (Phase 4)
* Component: QA

column3: Subject Expansion: Maths, Sciences, Technique, Économie & Gestion
column4:
h3. Goal
Load four more subjects onto the same engine: a KC graph, item bank, textbook corpus, glossary and misconception taxonomy per subject, plus the subject-specific widget packages and verifiers. Content tracks run in parallel from S9 under one subject lead each; Maths ships with the physics go-live, the rest in two waves after.

h3. Definition of Done
All five subjects live with ≥ 300 KCs and ≥ 4,000 calibrated items each; no engine code forked per subject; cross-subject daily planner active for every track.

h3. Scope
* 22 tickets, 207 story points
* Sprints 9–20 (Phase 6)
* Component: Curriculum
